summary: Production backup restore evidence proves the backup schedule, Postgres restore, object restore, RPO/RTO envelope, and immutable audit references for the backup/restore subitem. The aggregate production backup/rollback check remains blocked until CI and Private Beta/Staging gates are ready.

coverage.runtime_probe: Production backup scheduler probe verified the active Postgres and object backup schedule with the current release slot and immutable audit au-018.
coverage.deployment_evidence: The production evidence file records backup schedule active, backup manifest present, and RPO/RTO policy links.

coverage.runtime_probe: Production Postgres restore replay loaded the latest scheduled snapshot, verified migration schema compatibility, and matched expected row counts for release-critical tables.
coverage.deployment_evidence: Postgres restore verified true with restore_count_match and RPO/RTO inside policy.

coverage.runtime_probe: Production object restore replay recovered the export manifest and signed object metadata without exposing private object keys.
coverage.deployment_evidence: Object restore verified true with object manifest counts linked to audit refs.
